coverage: Docs: covered: 18 pages from five sites (Vercel, GitHub, Stripe, Atlassian, shadcn), the witness threshold of five sites and 15 pages. Marketing/landing: thin: 15 pages from three sites (Vercel, Stripe, Linear); Apple, Figma and Raycast left on the terms review, their terms barring robots. App/dashboard: thin: real logged-in app chrome is public only on GitHub's repository pages and in the shadcn examples; Linear, Vercel, Stripe and Figma dashboards need a login and are out. Form/checkout/settings: thin: one shadcn form demo and Stripe's checkout demo; settings pages all need a login. Data-dense tables: thin: a GitHub issue list and the shadcn task table. IBM Carbon left the corpus too: its terms are ambiguous about robots that data mine. No site gives more than half of an archetype's pages. The plan therefore lets only archetypes with enough references act as a witness (D5).

vercel.note: Admitted. Terms and AUP read: the scrape item binds customers' use of the platform, and automation is barred only to get around limits or security. robots.txt allows these pages; its Content-Signal says ai-train=no, and nothing here trains.

github.note: Admitted. The AUP lets researchers use public, non-personal information for research when the publication is open access: the bands are numbers in an open repository, no personal data. robots.txt allows these repository, issue and pull list pages.

stripe.note: Admitted. The services agreement governs the services and bars copying the website: nothing is copied, numbers only. robots.txt allows these stripe.com and docs.stripe.com pages; checkout.stripe.dev has none (404).

linear.note: Admitted. The AUP bars using the Services to scrape outside the APIs; it does not name the public site a Service, and nothing is extracted but numbers. robots.txt allows these pages.

carbon.note: Excluded. IBM's terms let a crawler crawl as robots.txt permits, and bar a robot that retrieves or data-mines the site's presentation: ambiguous for these pages, so the corpus leaves Carbon out. Its published numbers stay a frame of the bar.

atlassian.note: Admitted. The site links no terms of use; its license covers using the design system and names no automated access. robots.txt is absent (404), so every page is allowed.

shadcn.note: Admitted. The site links no terms; the project is open source. robots.txt allows /.

apple.note: Excluded. The site terms, which developer.apple.com links too, bar any robot, spider or other automatic device used to access, acquire, copy or monitor any portion of the site.

figma.note: Excluded. The AUP, clause 2(j), bars scraping, data mining, or otherwise accessing Figma or Figma content programmatically.

raycast.note: Excluded. The terms bar data mining, robots, scraping or similar data gathering or extraction methods.
